name: LADES
aliases: Linearly Annealed Dropout and Structure-Aware Early Stopping
Linearly Annealed Dropout with Structure-Aware Early Stopping
definition: LADES is a ground-truth-free optimization controller for sparse-view Gaussian tomography that mitigates PVFD by combining Linearly Annealed Dropout (LAD) and Structure-Aware Early Stopping (SAES).
summary: LADES is a ground-truth-free optimization controller for sparse-view 3D Gaussian tomography that mitigates projection-volume fidelity divergence via linearly annealed dropout and structure-aware early stopping.
